market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham is an established mid-table Premier League club with strong financial backing and a capable squad. Relegation is a rare event for such clubs, historically well below 15%, while the market implies a 34.5% chance. The discrepancy is too large to ignore.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023-24 and sits comfortably mid-table in 2024-25.
The club has not been relegated since 2010-11, demonstrating long-term stability.
Financial resources and squad depth are superior to clubs typically battling relegation.
sources_consulted: Club financial overview from public reports
